# 2028 Games Session Guide

> An unofficial guide to all 800+ sessions of the 2028 Summer Games in Los Angeles (July 10-30, 2028). Every session has a 0-10 rating of how worth attending it is, plus an AI-written summary, athletes to watch, related news, and venue facts. Ratings and writeups are generated by Claude from web research; verify details against official sources before buying tickets. Times are local Pacific time.

## For agents

- [MCP server](https://28games.tompiarulli.com/mcp): Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only). Tools: `search_sessions` (filter by sport, venue, zone, round, date range, minimum score, keyword), `get_session` (full guide to one session), `list_sports`, `list_venues`, `get_venue`.
- [All sessions as JSON](https://28games.tompiarulli.com/api/sessions.json): Every session's id, sport, event, round, ISO date, time, venue, zone, score and link, sorted by date.

## Pages

- [Session browser](https://28games.tompiarulli.com/): Filter and sort every session. Link to one session with `/?session=<id>`, e.g. `/?session=SWM05`.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/tompiarulli/2028-games-guide): How the data, ratings and writeups are produced.
